name: Input Buffer
description: In any gamemode, if a click or release would kill you but waiting a tick or two wouldn't, the input is delayed until it's safe.

max-delay.name: Max delay (ticks)
max-delay.description: How many physics ticks an input may be held back.

lookahead.name: Check ticks after input
lookahead.description: After the input lands (now or delayed), how many ticks are simulated to check for death. 2 matches: press, check the next 2 ticks.
